audience: online store and payments teams who screen orders for fraud with MaxMind minFraud

useCases.title: Get a quick fraud risk score for an order
useCases.text: The AI sends the IP address, email, billing and order details and returns the risk score, IP risk and disposition.

useCases.title: Read detailed risk insights for a suspicious order
useCases.text: The AI gets IP location, email, address and device details and the risk of each part, on top of the risk score.

useCases.title: Find out why an order scored high
useCases.text: The AI returns the risk score reasons and the subscores per factor. It explains in plain words what makes the order look risky.

useCases.title: Compare billing and shipping risk of an order
useCases.text: The AI scores an order with different billing and shipping places and points out what the mismatch adds to the risk.

useCases.title: Report the outcome of a transaction
useCases.text: The AI sends feedback to MaxMind with a tag, such as a chargeback or confirmed fraud, for a transaction identified by IP, MaxMind id, minFraud id or transaction id.
